incidents.title: Witnessed crash
incidents.summary: A registered driver was rear-ended at 53 Pythonsux Way. Dashcam footage from a nearby ActiveGuard user was shared with them. No claim is filed for the witness.

incidents.title: N2 collision
incidents.summary: Slowing for queued traffic on the N2, the insured Mazda was struck from behind. The other driver left the scene. Dashcam marks the impact at 14:06 with dry conditions and moderate traffic.

incidents.title: Footage processed
incidents.summary: Uploaded footage from 21 March 2025 was analysed. A single vehicle drifted onto the shoulder on Rhodes Drive and recovered without a collision.

incidents.title: Nearby crash
incidents.summary: A two-car crash was reported on Sunshine Lane, Mowbray. The insured vehicle was not involved. The alert is for local awareness.

incidents.title: Milnerton intersection
incidents.summary: At the Pienaar Road intersection a car turned across the insured vehicle. Front bumper and left headlamp were damaged. Both drivers exchanged details. Eligible for a claim.

closeCalls.title: Hard brake on Main Road
closeCalls.message: Close call: a taxi changed lanes without signalling on Main Road, Observatory. The driver braked hard. No contact.

closeCalls.title: Near miss on De Waal Drive
closeCalls.message: Close call: an oncoming vehicle crossed the centre line on De Waal Drive. The insured car moved left and avoided contact.

claims.description: Slowing for queued traffic on the N2, the insured Mazda CX-3 was struck from behind. The other driver left the scene. Dashcam footage places the impact at 14:06 in clear weather. Rear bumper and boot lid were damaged. No injuries reported.

At the Pienaar Road intersection another car turned across the path of the insured vehicle. The front bumper and left headlamp were damaged. Both drivers exchanged details. Dashcam footage is attached to this demo claim.

Analysed dashcam footage shows the vehicle drifting onto the shoulder on Rhodes Drive and recovering. There was no collision. This draft is kept so the claim form can be opened from the processed-footage notification.
